question: What are some ways for Lee's Market to enhance on-floor customer engagement to offset the impact of Canada’s July 2025 retail sales decline of 0.8% and drive a measurable rebound in the remaining months of 2025?

insights.question: What was the percentage dip in average customer dwell time on the sales floor between May and July 2025?
insights.answer: The percentage dip in average customer dwell time on the sales floor between May and July 2025 was 18%.

insights.question: What was the percentage dip in the number of product interactions per customer on the sales floor between May and July 2025?
insights.answer: The percentage dip in the number of product interactions per customer on the sales floor between May and July 2025 was 40%.

insights.question: How many of the top 10 seasonal SKUs underperformed from June to August 2025 compared to the same period in 2024?
insights.answer: Eight of the top 10 seasonal SKUs underperformed from June to August 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.

insights.question: By what percentage was the average order size of Asian customers higher than the average order size of non-Asian customers during July 2025?
insights.answer: The average order size of Asian customers was 18% higher than the average order size of non-Asian customers during July 2025.

insights.question: How much higher was the average basket value for customers who interacted with sales associates compared to those who shopped independently in July 2025?
insights.answer: The average basket value for customers who interacted with sales associates was 22% higher than for independent shoppers.

insights.question: What percentage of customers who received personalized product recommendations in July 2025 returned to make additional purchases in August 2025?
insights.answer: 35% of customers who received personalized recommendations returned for additional purchases in August 2025.
